ambiguity.note: Recall is the metric that matters: at a 34% base rate a judge that always says 'unambiguous' scores 66% agreement. Of the 6 false positives, at least three are our labelling errors, not the judge's - most clearly nq-001, where two 'Head of the Class' series exist and both were returned by the search.
